scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --ssr src/render.tsx --outDir .vite-ssr && node tools/prerender.mjs && node tools/static-check.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json tools/prerender.mjs tools/static-check.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json tools/prerender.mjs tools/static-check.mjs
